name: Bogdan Andrzej Zdrojewski - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the role of EU policies in shaping the European Sport Model
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on how the EU should protect the "European Sport Model" – the way sport in Europe is organised around open competitions, solidarity between professional and grassroots levels, and sport serving society, not just profit. It asks the European Commission for a long-term sport strategy, clearer guidance on how EU law applies to sport, more money for sport, and action on match-fixing, doping, online piracy and athletes' rights. It is not a law; it asks the Commission to act.

- The report is an opinion; no rules change yet. It asks the Commission for a long-term sport strategy and clearer legal guidance.
- It affects sports bodies, clubs, athletes, volunteers and fans across the EU.
- Next: the Commission decides whether to act on these requests.
